items.title: Audit the plan against current Lattice CLI surfaces
items.context: Verify story_get/checklist_get slim and fields support, command schemas, and existing smoke coverage referenced by the document.

happy.desc: The document claims about story_get/checklist_get slim and fields support match current handler and CLI schema surfaces.

edge.desc: The audit identifies stale or risky verification-command ordering, especially dist smoke commands that require a fresh build after TS changes.

adversarial.desc: The audit does not accept provider billing, prompt-cache, or Authority completion claims unless backed by explicit receipts or executable evidence.

items.userSees: User sees B-f495 audit evidence confirming the slim / fields CLI surfaces and smoke coverage either match the plan or list exact corrections.

items.title: Audit risk boundaries and verification discipline
items.context: Check that the plan preserves default full output, requires full output for evidence-sensitive work, and does not overclaim provider billing or Authority completion.

happy.desc: The document explicitly preserves default full story_get/checklist_get output and requires full output before evidence-sensitive conclusions or mutations.

edge.desc: The document distinguishes approximate context-token estimates from provider billing receipts and does not claim prompt-cache savings are proven.

adversarial.desc: The document excludes lifecycle gate, DONE, Authority receipt, and provider billing semantic changes from this low-risk plan.

items.userSees: User sees B-f495 audit evidence confirming the plan preserves full-output fallback, local-only evidence boundaries, and no Authority or billing overclaim.

items.title: Record audit disposition and required follow-up
items.context: Summarize pass/fail findings, recommended document edits, and whether implementation should proceed as a separate story.

happy.desc: The final audit disposition is recorded in the document with accepted findings, required fixes, and implementation follow-up guidance.

edge.desc: The document explains that implementation should run as a separate Lattice story and follow ordinary REVIEW plus automatic 3x2/degraded 3x1 escalation when triggered.

adversarial.desc: The audit result does not mutate unrelated active story B-acec and does not rely on lattice audit writing B-META findings for this document review.

items.userSees: User sees a concise B-f495 audit disposition stating accepted claims, required document fixes, verification commands, and whether implementation should proceed separately.
